SELECT BOOKSET_ID id,BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET
AND BOOKSET_TYPE = #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT wtfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as code FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL wtfpdt WHERE wtfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) union SELECT tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as code FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt WHERE tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))
SELECT DISTINCT fri.BENCHMARK_ID as code FROM FIN_RATE_INFO fri WHERE fri.BENCHMARK_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))
